reviews.text: Ho preso la colorazione pink beam ed è bellissima. Non rimane molto acceso ma, esattamente come nella descrizione, resta uno scintillio che riflette rosa da tutte le angolazioni. Sulla mia pelle pallida neutra/fredda rimane molto bene!
reviews.zh: 我選咗 pink beam 色，好靚。唔會好鮮明，但係正如描述所講，會留住一種粉紅色嘅閃爍，由各個角度都反射粉紅色。喺我嘅蒼白中性／冷調皮膚上效果好好！

reviews.text: es muy lindo, las partículas de brillo son diminutas, por lo que no se ve un glitter grande en la mejilla, el color es hermoso, me encantó
reviews.zh: 好可愛，閃粉粒子好細，所以喺面頰上唔會見到大粒嘅閃粉，顏色好靚，我好鍾意。

reviews.text: Lo compré para dar un brillo natural en maquillajes del día a día y funciona perfecto para eso. tampoco se desvanece con el pasar de las horas lo cual a mí que tengo piel mixta me ayuda un montón porque no me dura mucho el maquillaje!
reviews.zh: 我買嚟喺日常化妝時製造自然嘅光澤，效果好好。亦都唔會隨住時間褪色，呢點對我幫助好大，因為我係混合皮膚，我嘅妝通常唔會持久！

reviews.text:
very nicely surprised ! It's what I wanted the Rare Beauty one to be, but better. 
The product itself is bigger than I thought it would be, the texture is dry but incredibly soft and applies beautifully ! It's perfect for a natural healthy glow, leaves no cast, just a lovely silky satin sheen. I got it in shade 01 Natural Beam
reviews.zh: 非常驚喜！係我想 Rare Beauty 嗰款會係咁，但係更好。個產品本身比我想像中大，質地乾身但好軟，塗抹好好。好適合自然健康嘅光澤，唔會留低偏色，只係有一層好靚嘅絲滑緞面光澤。我揀嘅係 01 Natural Beam 色。

reviews.text: I've always wanted to try a blue highlighter. At first, in the pan, it didn’t look too promising — kind of dry and glittery. But once I applied it with a brush, it looked almost wet on the skin. So beautiful! Especially if you’re very fair-skinned, the blue really pops.
reviews.zh: 我一直想試藍色高光。一開始喺盤入面，睇落唔係太好——有啲乾身，亦有啲閃粉感。但係用刷子塗咗之後，喺皮膚上睇落好似濕潤咁。好靚！特別係如果你好白皙，藍色會好突出。

reviews.text: The glow of this highlighter is amazing. It’s a very high quality product. I highly recommend it for an amazing glow.
reviews.zh: 呢款高光嘅光澤好正。佢係一款質素好高嘅產品。我好推薦，為咗有一個好正嘅光澤。

reviews.text: I really like it, it’s very pigmented and looks so glowy! It looks good with my cool undertone, I’m very happy with it!
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意，色素好濃，好有光澤！配我嘅冷調底色好好，我好滿意！
